DECLARE

 v_hold_code VARCHAR2(6);
 alert_id NUMBER;

 v_user_id VARCHAR2(8);
 clr_exception EXCEPTION;

 remove_status VARCHAR2(500);
 v_elig_status VARCHAR2(5);
 v_count number:=0;
 szUnitId VARCHAR2(15);
 szCredit NUMBER:=0;
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.f_re_scaned_unit_id is null then
 show_error('18042');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;

 --item_change('ctrl_blk_1.s_re_scan_unit_id','D');
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id!=:ctrl_blk_1.f_re_scaned_unit_id then 
 show_error('16123');
 raise clr_exception;
 end if;

 --- Added by Edwin on 05-10-2001

 if length(:ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id)=15 then 
 szUnitId:=substr(:ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id,1,13);
 else
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id;
 end if;


 select donor_id into v_donor_id from donations where unit_id=szUnitId and
 coll_date=:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date;
 
 
 select decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,3),'OPS',substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5),LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid) into v_user_id from dual;
 
 donor_eligibility (v_donor_id,v_elig_status);

 UPDATE_INTERDICTIONS(v_donor_id,v_status,szUnitId);
 
 IF v_status='OK' then
 
 If nvl(:global.ori_proc_code,'')=:ctrl_blk_1.s_proc_code then
 update donations set n_audit_flag='Y',n_audit_user=v_user_id,n_audit_date=sysdate,
 donor_signature_flag=:ctrl_blk_1.s_signature,
 donation_type=:ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type,procedure_code=:ctrl_blk_1.s_proc_code 
 where unit_id=szUnitId;
 Else
 Begin
 select nvl(credit_count,0) into szCredit from 
 valid_proc_codes where procedure_code=:ctrl_blk_1.s_proc_code 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate);
 Exception when others then 
 szCredit:=1; 
 End;
 update donations set n_audit_flag='Y',n_audit_user=v_user_id,n_audit_date=sysdate,
 donor_signature_flag=:ctrl_blk_1.s_signature,credit_count=szCredit,
 donation_type=:ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type,procedure_code=:ctrl_blk_1.s_proc_code 
 where unit_id=szUnitId;
 End If;
 

 REMOVE_HOLDS('DRDEF',v_donor_id,v_user_id,remove_status);
 if remove_status !='OK' then
 raise user_except1;
 end if;

 If form_success then
 :system.message_level:=10;

PROCEDURE pop_reason(pl_physical_code IN VARCHAR2,
 pl_reason OUT VARCHAR2,
 pl_inter OUT VARCHAR2,
 pl_status OUT VARCHAR2) IS
 -- MLT 1233 changes
 -- master codes table added to cursor to check for numeral_value flag.
 -- a value of 1 is a special case for TBV phy code where we need to check for equip type and age requirement 
 cursor cur_phy(pl_sysdate in date) is
 select vpr.*
 from valid_physical_rules vpr, valid_master_codes vmc
 where vpr.physical_code = vmc.code
 and vmc.code_type = 'PHYCD'
 and vpr.physical_code = pl_physical_code
 and vpr.donation_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type
 and vpr.procedure_code = :ctrl_blk_1.s_proc_code
 and ( -- MLT 1233
 ( vmc.numeral_value = 1
 and global_var.n_donor_age between NVL(vpr.from_age,global_var.n_donor_age-1) and NVL(vpr.to_age, global_var.n_donor_age+1)
 and vpr.equip_type = global_var.equip_type
 )
 or
 (vmc.numeral_value <> 1)
 )
 and vpr.data_type in ('N', 'D') -- ='N' -- Modified for IM:9358/9359
 and vpr.gender in ('A', :ctrl_blk_1.s_sex) -- SCR 21483
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date_time between vpr.eff_date and nvl(vpr.term_date, pl_sysdate + 1); -- SCR 18113

 v_rec valid_physical_rules%rowtype;
 v_reason varchar2(100);
 v_inter varchar2(5);
 v_max_val number;
 v_value number;
 v_data_type VARCHAR2(1);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,
 sysdate,
 chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;

 if cur_phy%isopen then
 close cur_phy;
 end if;

 open cur_phy(chp_sysdate);
 FETCH cur_phy
 into v_rec;

 IF cur_phy%NOTFOUND then
 pl_status := 'INVALID';
 ELSE
 
 Begin
 IF v_rec.data_type IN ('N', 'D') THEN
 -- ='N' then -- Modified for IM:9358/9359
 
 If v_rec.item_operator = 'BETWEEN' then
 
 v_value := to_number(v_rec.item_value);
 v_max_val := to_number(v_rec.item_value_max);
 
 if to_number(:physical_findings.physical_value) not between
 v_value and v_max_val then
 v_inter := v_rec.inter_code;
 v_reason := 'Value should be in between ' || v_rec.item_value ||
 ' - ' || to_char(v_max_val);
 ---display_item('physical_findings.s_reason','hold_attr');
 :physical_findings.s_def_status := 'Y';
 end if;
 End if;
 
 If v_rec.item_operator = 'MORE' then
 
 v_value := to_number(v_rec.item_value);
 v_max_val := to_number(v_rec.item_value_max);
 
 if to_number(:physical_findings.physical_value) > v_value then
 v_inter := v_rec.inter_code;
 v_reason := 'Value should be less than or eqaul to ' ||
 v_rec.item_value;
 ---display_item('physical_findings.s_reason','hold_attr');
 :physical_findings.s_def_status := 'Y';
 end if;
 
 End if;
 
 If v_rec.item_operator = 'LESS' then
 v_value := to_number(v_rec.item_value);
 v_max_val := to_number(v_rec.item_value_max);
 
 if to_number(:physical_findings.physical_value) < v_value then
 v_inter := v_rec.inter_code;
 v_reason := 'Value should be greater than or equal ' ||
 v_rec.item_value;
 ---display_item('physical_findings.s_reason','hold_attr');
 :physical_findings.s_def_status := 'Y';
 end if;
 End if;
 ELSE
 null;
 END IF;
 
 Exception
 when value_error then
 null;
 End;
 
 pl_inter := v_inter;
 pl_reason := v_reason;
 pl_status := 'OK';
 
 END IF;

Exception
 WHEN OTHERS then
 HANDLE_ERROR;
END;

PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

PROCEDURE validate_item(pl_data_type out varchar2) IS
/* SCR 19683- copied from onihlths - check onihlths for additional comments
 Only difference is validate_item parameters are different compared to onihlths. Functional logic is same. */
 v_temp number;
 v_num number;
 v_char number;
 v_phy_value varchar2(10);
 v_lov boolean;
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 v_phy_value:=ltrim(:physical_value,'0123456789.');

 /* if the entered value is charater type then check the valid physical rules table 
 whether the answer is there or not. */


 IF v_phy_value is not null then 
 SELECT nvl(count(*),0) into v_char from valid_physical_rules where 
 donation_type=:ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type and procedure_code=:ctrl_blk_1.s_proc_code and
 physical_code=:physical_findings.physical_code and
 item_value=:physical_findings.physical_value and data_type='C' and
 gender in ('A', :ctrl_blk_1.s_sex) and -- SCR 21483
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1); -- SCR 18113;
 --:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);
 
 If v_char=0 and :physical_findings.physical_value!='U' then

 /* if the entered valus is character data type, but there are answer sitting
 in the table whose data type is numeric for the same physical code */
 SELECT nvl(count(*),0) into v_num from valid_physical_rules where 
 donation_type=:ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type and procedure_code=:ctrl_blk_1.s_proc_code and 
 physical_code=:physical_findings.physical_code and data_type in ('N', 'D') and -- ='N' and SCR 19683 - 'D' datatype also part of numeric type.
 gender in ('A', :ctrl_blk_1.s_sex) and -- SCR 21483
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1); -- SCR 18113
 --:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1);


 if v_num> 0 then
 data_type_check;
 else
 --show_error('16132');
 show_error('16117');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 End if;

 pl_data_type:='C';

 ELSE /* If the entered valuse is nummeric */
 -- Added on 04/04/2013; SCR 19683
 DECLARE
 l_cur_found BOOLEAN;
 l_data_type VARCHAR2(1);
 /* Cursor to get numeric data type of physical codes - only checking for 'N' OR 'D' data type. - (Format - Whole Number 'N' or Decimal 'D')*/ 
 CURSOR vpr_cur IS
 SELECT vpr.data_type
 FROM valid_physical_rules vpr
 WHERE vpr.donation_type = :CTRL_BLK_1.s_don_type AND
 vpr.procedure_code = :CTRL_BLK_1.s_proc_code AND
 vpr.physical_code = :PHYSICAL_FINDINGS.PHYSICAL_CODE AND
 vpr.data_type in ('N', 'D') AND
 gender in ('A', :ctrl_blk_1.s_sex) and -- SCR 21483
 :CTRL_BLK_1.s_collection_date_time BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1); -- SCR 18113
 --:CTRL_BLK_1.s_collection_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, chp_sysdate+1);
 BEGIN 
 -- Only one record is needed.
 OPEN vpr_cur;
 FETCH vpr_cur INTO l_data_type;
 l_cur_found := vpr_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE vpr_cur;
 
 IF l_cur_found THEN -- Record found.
 pl_data_type:='N'; -- This will be set as 'N' for both Number and Decimal datatype. 
 IF l_data_type = 'N' THEN -- Allow only whole numbers;
 IF NOT regexp_like(:physical_findings.physical_value, '^[0-9]+$') THEN -- Display error if not whole number.
 show_error('16230');
 check_package_failure;
 --szError := '16230'; 
 END IF;
 ELSIF l_data_type = 'D' THEN -- Allow only valid decimals.
 --IF NOT regexp_like(:physical_findings.physical_value, '^(\.[0-9]+|[0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?)$') THEN -- Display error if not valid decimals. Valid Decimals:( ".0", "0.0", "0.", "0" (integer of course) but not ".") See notes at the end;
 IF NOT regexp_like(:physical_findings.physical_value, '^(\.[0-9]+|[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)$') THEN -- Display error if not valid decimals. Valid Decimals:( ".0", "0.0", but not ".") See notes at the end;
 show_error('16134');
 check_package_failure;
 --szError := '16134'; 
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
 ELSE -- l_cur_found IS FALSE; (No records found)
 pl_data_type:='C';
 show_error('16117');
 check_package_failure;
 --szError:='16117'; 
 END IF; 
 END; 
 -- End Change; 
 End if; 
END;

declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;
